stem.text: A mixture of ethanol and methanol is burned in oxygen to produce $35\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $\text{CO}_2$ and $55\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of $\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
Complete combustion occurs and the volumes of both products are measured at $101\,\text{kPa}$ and $120\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$.
What is the molar ratio, ethanol:methanol, in the mixture?
